problem: LiDAR mapping odometry initialised in a POSHOLD hover then stayed Held (insufficient overlap) for the rest of the flight.
scope: Mapping-only scan odometry (lidar_odometry.py). No flight-decision, avoidance, launch or parameter change.
root_causes: Fixed 40 mm RMSE gate sits at the RPLIDAR C1 noise floor (adjacent-pair median 37 mm, 38% > 40 mm); 20 mm recovery gate unreachable.
Aircraft drifted ~1.4 m (FCU local position, up to 0.86 m/s, pitch +3..-6 deg); held mapper kept a stale seed against a keyframe it had left and recovery required <=0.15 m from the last pose.
ICP limit-cycled at sub-mm steps on noisy scans, failing the 0.2 mm convergence test.
changes: fallback registration to the previous accepted scan when the keyframe fails
held dead reckoning via anchor/previous-scan registration seeding keyframe re-registration
chain re-acquisition with <=1 constant-velocity scan under the 2 m/s / 90 deg/s average bound

evidence.robustness: 30 replays (5 mm jitter x 6 seeds incl. none, 5 start points): new 0 ended held, longest hold 8, >=97% tracked; old 30/30 ended held

error_vs_fcu_local_position_m.note: FCU is 2 Hz interpolated EKF output, not ground truth; attitude-induced 2D bias remains

evidence.tests: WSL Jazzy: sim/test_lidar_odometry.py 11 passed; against original module 4 new tests fail (noise floor, real drift fixture, two new-path safety tests)
